title: Amoeba Uncovered: Types, Infections & the Deadly Brain-Eating amoeba അമീബ മസ്തിഷ്കജ്വരം #malayalam
description:
What exactly is an amoeba, and how can such a tiny organism pose deadly risks to humans? 🦠
In this video, we explore:
What amoebas are and how they live
Different types of amoebas you should know about
Common amoeba-related infections and symptoms
The terrifying truth behind Naegleria fowleri — the brain-eating amoeba 😱
We’ll break down how this rare but deadly parasite invades the brain, where it's commonly found, and most importantly—how you can stay safe.

If you're curious about microbiology, infectious diseases, or just want to know what’s lurking in warm freshwater, this video is a must-watch!

🔔 Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more science and wildlife videos! #അമീബ #Amoeba #BrainEatingAmoeba #Microbiology #Infections #NaegleriaFowleri #ScienceExplained #healthawareness
